Its exact-tree 600+600-second diagnostic report has SHA-256 d04b4a111d004e5466838f25f85e568bf0dd2c84c5649de5f39402188b2199df; both elections activated four controller IDs, eight pool stakes were accepted, and four matured first-round pool credits recovered. A separate PQ identity regression in the tosctl daemon compared the elector's validator_id with an Ed25519 ADNL transport public key, and the finished-election check compared that validator_id with the operator wallet. e2d0b3e7d changed both to controller identity and added distinct-id behavioral fixtures; this fixes participant recognition but does not close the remaining classical-stake tooling question.
